windows11.note: GitHub Actions windows-2022 is a Windows Server 2022 image (Win11-generation kernel/userland). CI proves Win11-class server image build+test.

windows10.note: Win10 x64 is supported by the Electron/NSIS target matrix; this CI image does not boot Windows 10 — support is by product target policy, not by a Win10 VM in this gate.

displayScales.note: Electron Chromium DPI awareness; prior V2-5.5 UAT covered scale dataset
